scenario: Compile error policy — emitting an unknown schema is a hard compile failure per LERR.1.1. A rule that emits a schema name that has never been declared rejects at compile time with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_SCHEMA.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    emit NonExistentSchema logical dummy: 0
